title: Alliances Director - Managed Services Partnerships
jobDescription:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

The individual will play a leading role in alignment with the global partner strategy of Anaplan, serving as the Partner GTM lead for Managed Services Heritage firms (e.g., TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Infosys). This role focuses on the global activation of these SI partnerships, working to incubate, establish, and grow strategic relationships from currently opportunistic ones, ensuring full alignment to set growth objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Grow Partner-Led Revenue: The core focus is building and growing partner-led revenue (both sourced and engaged) globally with Managed Services Heritage firms.
  • Incubate and Elevate Partnerships: Transform opportunistic relationships into established, growing, and strategic global partnerships.
  • Executive Alignment: Build, foster, and facilitate executive sponsorships and relationships to ensure close collaboration and support across key business stakeholders globally.
  • Enablement and Joint GTM: Onboard, enable, and build joint sales plays and offerings with strategic SI partners. Define clear strategic partner alignment to support sales, increase wallet-share in accounts by origination, and secure new customers.
  • Market Connection: Connect and establish local sales relationships across various global markets to drive demand generation and joint business opportunities.
  • Solution Development: Develop deep knowledge of Anaplan offerings and services to expand the partners' portfolio, creating differentiated joint solutions that broaden and deepen market coverage to build incremental revenue growth.
  • Performance Monitoring: Continuously review and develop global partnership engagements and services metrics, monitor performance, and implement appropriate plans to attain continued results.

Aptitude

  • Lead by example, advocate, and set appropriate expectations to foster strong global collaboration between Anaplan teams and go-to-market partners.
  • Provide effective leadership and management to ensure partners are highly engaged and delivering to set KPIs.
  • Ensure active communication of vision, priorities, and progress to the business to foster engagement, awareness, and motivation.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing investment and development of partner resources; build up skilled and qualified customer success capabilities.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvement and sharing of best practices across global markets.
  • Awareness and understanding of the global regulatory framework in which the partners operate, ensuring adherence to Anaplan's policies, procedures, requirements, and compliance relevant to the role.

Ideal Candidate

  • Specific SI Experience: Deep knowledge of and prior experience working directly with Managed Services Heritage firms (e.g., TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Infosys).
  • Global Navigation: Demonstrated ability to successfully navigate, execute, and build relationships in a cross-market global capacity.
  • Strategic Growth: Proven experience in building, growing, and executing strategic SI relationships and transforming opportunistic connections into strategic partnerships.
  • SaaS solutions experience.
  • Reputation as a thought leader and solid communicator of business value.
  • Strong connector, collaborative, and team-oriented.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Total of 12+ years in technology with significant relevant experience in sales and/or partner management.
  • Deep knowledge of the global System Integrators landscape, particularly Managed Services Heritage firms, including markets, solutions, and GTMs.
  • Outstanding track record of success in selling SaaS solutions.
  • Solid reputation as a thought leader and communicator of business value.
  • Proven track record of incubating, establishing, and growing strategic partner-led revenue (sourced and engaged) globally.
  • Open to global travel as required.

  • Bachelor's degree in business (Finance, Operations, Accounting, etc.) or highly technical field (Engineering, mathematics, data analytics, etc.)
  • Passion for business analytics, modeling, and planning
  • 2+ years of Anaplan model-building experience with at least 1 large and complex ground-up build
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent verbal, written, and computer communication skills with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Motivated self-starter
  • Experience working autonomously and collaboratively in a rapid-growth environment

  • End-to-end Anaplan deployment experience;
  • Consulting experience or academic research in a technical field (economics, engineering, science, math, etc.);
  • Experience collaborating on dynamic projects with HR, finance, accounting, product, and/or engineering teams;

Business Title - Coupa Program Manager

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Coupa Administrator to take ownership and provide strategic leadership for our Coupa ecosystem. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who is passionate about building a world-class Procure-to-Pay function. You will be the organization's foremost expert on Coupa, accountable for its performance, roadmap, and adoption.

A key part of your mission will be to act as a strategic and influential partner to the Procurement department, guiding them on best practices and shaping how the platform is run to maximize efficiency and value. You will also serve as the technical lead and mentor for our other team members who assist with Coupa operations, helping to elevate their skills and ensure operational excellence.

  • The role requires to work in the US shift to support US stakeholders (The latest end time for the shift will be around mid-night IST).

Key Responsibilities

  • Assume primary ownership of the Coupa platform, serving as the lead strategist responsible for its day-to-day stability and long-term strategic improvements.
  • Architect and implement end-to-end P2P solutions, driving the adoption of new features and managing platform release cycles.
  • Influence and guide the Procurement team on process optimization, ensuring the platform's configuration and usage align with strategic business goals.
  • Guide, mentor, and upskill team members
  • Serve as the escalation point for the most complex technical issues, including integration troubleshooting and advanced configuration challenges.
  • Maintain and optimize all core Coupa configurations (e.g., business rules, approval chains, chart of accounts, suppliers).
  • Proactively monitor and enforce data quality standards across supplier data, catalogs, and accounting structures.
  • Perform basic ad-hoc operational tasks in Workday Financials as needed to assist the wider finance team.
  • Create and own all documentation for processes, configurations, and best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in a Coupa-focused role with a clear progression towards platform ownership and strategy.
  • Deep, expert-level knowledge of Coupa modules, including Procure-to-Order (P2O), and their underlying architecture.
  • Proven ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders and business partners, particularly within Procurement functions.
  • Strong understanding of system configuration, business rules, complex approval workflows, user roles, and integration points.
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance
  • Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and lead through influence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant experience with Coupa integrations, particularly with ERP systems like Workday Financials.
  • Configuration experience on Workday Financials
  • Experience in change management, process documentation, or developing internal training programs.
  • Coupa certifications (e.g., Coupa Admin, Coupa Certified Professional, Solutions Architect) are a strong plus.

Integrated Business Applications - Team Leader - India (15+ years)

Team Description

Anaplan applications are the strategic pillar of the Anaplan strategy, bringing best-in-class planning capabilities to our customers built on the Anaplan platform. As the Offshore Application Team Leader, you will establish and lead a new 25-person hub in India, providing a key capability for scaling our applications offering and serving as the vital bridge to our UK and US Centers of Excellence. This pivotal role delivers additional global capacity, flexible resource and is integral in taking our applications product organization to the next level.

Your Impact

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, inspire, and manage a newly established, high-performing offshore team of approximately 25 professionals, including Anaplan Model Builders, Solution Architects, QA engineers, and Product Owners.
  • Act as the primary onsite representative and leader in India, fostering a strong team culture aligned with global organizational values.
  • Drive line management, conduct performance evaluations, and actively mentor individuals to support their career progression.
  • Cultivate a strong "engineering mindset" within the team, ensuring that even without traditional software coding, the team applies rigorous, structural, and scalable thinking to model building.

Delivery Excellence

  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery and health of Anaplan application builds, ensuring projects meet strict quality, timeline, and budget expectations.
  • Establish and enforce robust QA and testing processes tailored to the Anaplan platform to minimize defects and technical debt.
  • Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and prioritize workloads across multiple project streams to optimize the team's output.
  • Identify, escalate, and proactively mitigate delivery risks before they impact the business.

Technical Strategy & Collaboration

  • Serve as the critical, strategic interface between the offshore delivery center in India and the onshore Application Centers of Excellence (CoEs) based in the UK and US.
  • Translate onshore architectural visions and technical strategies into actionable delivery plans for the offshore team.
  • Facilitate seamless, daily collaboration across time zones, actively removing blockers and ensuring the offshore team has the context needed to succeed.
  • Align the offshore team's output with global Anaplan architecture guidelines and governance standards.

Platform & Product Mindset

  • Champion a product-centric approach to Anaplan application development, shifting the focus from mere task execution to delivering true business value.
  • Guide the team in understanding the broader business context and user needs behind the models they are building.
  • Ensure the adoption of Anaplan best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Ensuring that the team focus on building broad configurable applications considering how different customers may have different needs for otherwise similar functionality

Your Qualifications

Leadership & Management

  • Proven track record of building, managing, and scaling technology or platform delivery teams (ideally 20+ members) in an offshore/nearshore model.
  • Extensive experience in line management, performance evaluation, and team motivation.

  • Architect and shipReact + TypeScriptfeatures with strongcomponent design,hooks, andperformancetuning (render paths, memoization, code splitting, lazy loading).

  • Ownrelease to production: release trains, rollback judgment, coordination with SRE/platform,Harness/Argo CDpipelines.

Required qualifications
Core web (expert-level application)
  • DeepHTML/CSSskills applied through design systems, not ad-hoc styling.
  • AdvancedTypeScript(generics, discriminated unions, utility types, strict typing for API models).
  • Web Componentsliteracy (custom elements, shadow DOM, interoperability with React hosts where applicable).
React platform leadership
  • 5+ years building large, long-lived frontend products; 3+ years leading features inReact.
  • Provenperformanceoptimization in data-heavy UIs (virtualization, debouncing, selector patterns, profiling).
  • Strongcomponent API design: composability, accessibility props, testability, and extension points.
Architecture & tooling
  • Production experience withmonorepos(pnpm,Nx), shared packages, and internal design libraries.
  • Viteand/orWebpackexpertise; familiarity withmodule federationandmicrofrontendoperational concerns.
  • GraphQLclient patterns (caching, error policies, colocated queries) plus robustRESTclient abstractions.
  • BFFcollaboration: shaping payloads for UI needs, auth/session handling at the edge of frontend concerns.
Quality, security & operations
  • Testing leadership:RTL+Vitest, meaningful coverage of behavior (not implementation detail); E2E strategy withPlaywright/Cucumber.
  • Hands-onvulnerability remediation(Snyk, npm audits,SASTtriage) and secure dependency management.
  • Production debugging andobservability(Grafana,Splunk); SLO-aware mindset for customer-impacting defects.
  • CI/CD and release ownership (GitHub Actionsor equivalent,Harness,Argo CD).
Leadership & delivery
  • Track record mentoring engineers and raising code quality through reviews and standards.
  • Strong stakeholder communication (Jira, RFCs, estimations, risk callouts).
  • Experience taking features through full lifecycle including production rollout and post-release monitoring.
Nice to have
  • React Native+ native build/debug (Xcode/Android tooling) for shared mobile roadmap/ Next js
  • Storybook+ visual regression strategy for ADS consumers.
  • Feature flag frameworks and experimentation patterns.
  • Prior enterprise SaaS: multi-tenant UX, permissions, auditability, enterprise admin surfaces.
  • Experience withdrag-and-dropframeworks, canvas/SVG charting, and accessibility in non-standard widgets.
  • Platform engineering overlap: containerized dev envs, service mesh basics, API gateway familiarity (conceptual).

automated solutions.
The ideal candidate has experience working in a large-scale enterprise or
global cloud service provider network, with strong knowledge of networking
principles, and an understanding of networking in AWS, GCP and Azure. They

network automation and using configuration management and automation

switching, and firewalling.

working knowledge of common protocols such as Ethernet, IP (v4 and v6),

What you’ll be doing:
As a Senior Security Engineer embedded within the Security Operations team,you will design, build, and continuously improve the technical capabilities that underpin how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats. You will work at the intersection of engineering and operations — turning security problems into scalable, automated solutions. Your core responsibilities will be to:

  • SIEM Engineering: Own the engineering of our SIEM platform, includingonboarding and normalizing log sources, building and maintaining,parsers, and ensuring high-fidelity data pipelines that underpin, detection and investigation. Work to continuously improve log coverage,data quality, and platform performance.
  • Detection Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain a library of high-quality detections using a Detection as Code methodology — managingdetection content through version control, peer review, and automated, testing pipelines. Map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and work to continuously improve coverage, precision, and resilience
    against evasion.
  • SOAR & Automation: Build and maintain automated workflows and playbooks using SOAR platforms to streamline alert triage, enrichment, and response. Identify manual and repetitive processes across the security operations lifecycle and engineer solutions that allow the team to operate at scale.
  • AI-Augmented Security Operations: Explore and operationalize the use of AI and machine learning to enhance security operations capabilities— including alert triage, incident response acceleration, threat intelligence analysis, threat hunting, and the enrichment and prioritization of detection content. Evaluate emerging AI tooling and work to embed it responsibly into team workflows.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Consume and operationalize threat intelligence from internal and external sources, integrating indicators and adversary context into detection logic, SOAR playbooks, and hunting activities. Work with threat intelligence feeds and platforms to ensure actionable intelligence flows into security operations in a timely
    and structured way.
  • Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the environment to identify attacker activity that evades existing detections. Document and share findings in a structured way, using hunt outcomes to directly inform and improve detection engineering and tooling.
  • Incident Response Support: Provide engineering-level support during security incidents, assisting with investigation, containment, and recovery. Contribute to post-incident reviews and translate lessons learned into improved detections, playbooks, and tooling.

What you’ll bring to the role:
We are looking for a technically strong security professional with hands-on experience building and operating security capabilities in complex
environments. The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Technical Security Experience: Significant experience in a security engineering, DevSecOps, or equivalent role with a strong background in securing cloud-native environments and modern application stacks.
  • Detection & Response Skills: Practical experience developing and tuning SIEM detections, writing threat hunting queries, and participating in
    incident response activities.
  • SecOps Tooling: Hands-on knowledge of administering and operating core security operations tools, including SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), EDR/XDR solutions, vulnerability scanners, and ticketing or case management systems. Experience integrating these tools to support detection, investigation, and response workflows.
  • Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting: Experience working with threat intelligence platforms and feeds (e.g. MISP, Recorded Future, VirusTotal), and integrating intelligence into security tooling, detection logic, and operational processes. A working knowledge of threat hunting methodologies and the ability to proactively identify indicators of
    compromise or attacker behavior across the environment is highly desirable.
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, Go, Bash) to build security tooling,
    automate workflows, and integrate security capabilities.
  • Application Security Knowledge: Familiarity with secure development practices, OWASP top risks, and the ability to perform code reviews or
    work with developers to remediate security findings.
  • Security Frameworks & Standards: Working knowledge of relevant security frameworks (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK) and compliance standards such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong ability to articulate technical security risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to work cross-functionally to deliver security outcomes.
  • Incident Response & Digital Forensics: Hands-on experience leading or supporting security incident investigations, including evidence preservation, log and artifact analysis, timeline reconstruction, and root cause identification. Familiarity with forensic tooling and methodologies is highly sought after, as is experience contributing to post-incident
    reviews and translating findings into actionable improvements.

Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Certificate Management

As a Senior Infrastructure Services Engineer specialising in Certificate Management, you will play a key role in designing, operating, and evolving our enterprise certificate management platform. This platform supports thousands of certificates across a global multi-cloud and on-premise environment.

You will focus on building a scalable, automated, and sustainable certificate management capability that enables service teams to manage their certificates through self-service workflows while ensuring strong governance, security, and visibility across the organisation.

Working closely with domain architecture, security, and platform teams, you will help define and implement the future state of certificate lifecycle management, automation, and observability.

The long-term objective of this role is to minimise manual certificate operations by engineering automation, self-service capabilities, and platform integrations that allow service teams to securely manage certificate lifecycles at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and operate the organisation’s central certificate management platform supporting both public and internal certificates.

Work with architecture and security teams to define and implement enterprise standards for certificate lifecycle management, including issuance, renewal, revocation, and domain control validation (DCV).

Engineer automation that enables scalable and sustainable certificate operations across thousands of certificates in multi-cloud and on-prem environments.

Develop integrations and automation workflows to support automated certificate issuance, renewal, and lifecycle management.

Implement certificate discovery and inventory capabilities to ensure full visibility of certificates deployed across the environment.

Build supporting automation and integrations using scripting and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Python, Terraform, and Ansible.

Enable service teams to manage certificates through federated self-service capabilities while maintaining central governance and policy enforcement.

Improve observability of certificate health and lifecycle status through metrics, logging, dashboards, and alerting.

Integrate certificate lifecycle monitoring into the organisation’s observability stack.

Partner with platform, infrastructure, and service teams to integrate certificate lifecycle processes into service delivery workflows.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex certificate lifecycle issues and drive improvements that reduce manual operational effort.

Maintain clear documentation, architectural diagrams, and operational runbooks for the certificate management platform.

Continuously evolve the platform to support changing industry requirements such as shorter certificate lifespans and updated domain validation processes.

Validate certificate signing requests and TLS certificate contents using tools such as openssl to ensure compliance with modern certificate standards and prevent issuance errors.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience working in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or site reliability roles.

Strong understanding of TLS/PKI fundamentals and certificate lifecycle management.

Experience operating or integrating with enterprise certificate management platforms.

Experience developing automation and integrations using scripting or programming languages such as Python or similar.

Practical experience automating infrastructure or operational workflows using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or comparable automation frameworks.

Experience working in distributed infrastructure environments spanning cloud and on-premise platforms.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex production environments.

Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including security, platform engineering, and service owners.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Desired Skills

Experience working with certificate lifecycle management platforms such as AppViewX, Sectigo, or CyberArk.

Experience integrating with public certificate authorities such as DigiCert, Let’s Encrypt, SSL.com, or GlobalSign.

Experience implementing automated certificate lifecycle workflows using protocols such as ACME, EST (Enrollment over Secure Transport), or SCEP (Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol).

Experience managing distributed certificate authorities, certificate revocation lists (CRLs), and Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) services.

Experience with private certificate authorities such as AWS Private CA, HashiCorp Vault CA, or Microsoft Certificate Services.

Knowledge of different types of certificates used in enterprise environments and their use cases (e.g., TLS/SSL, mTLS, client authentication, service-to-service communication).

Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ElasticSearch/OpenSearch.

Experience supporting infrastructure across multi-cloud and on-premise environments.

Experience working with containers and container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.

Working knowledge of Linux systems and operating environments.

Experience validating certificate signing requests and certificate metadata using tools such as openssl.

Understanding of industry trends impacting certificate lifecycle management, including shorter certificate lifetimes and evolving domain control validation requirements.

  • Track and report program status, risks, and KPIs to executive leadership and agency stakeholders.

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Security, Public Administration, or related field (equivalent experience considered).
  • 6+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 3–5 years directly leading compliance, security, or risk programs.
  • Hands-on experience with FedRAMP (authorization process, continuous monitoring, working with 3PAOs and agency sponsors) is required.
  • Demonstrated experience managing ISO 27001, SOC 2, and HITRUST CSF certification/audit cycles, plus exposure to other international market-access certifications (e.g., ISO 27701, TISAX, or regional data protection frameworks).
  • Working knowledge of federal contracting requirements (CMMC, NIST 800-171/800-53).
  • Strong track record managing complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior executives, auditors, and government stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and risk-assessment skills, with the ability to translate regulatory language into practical operational requirements.
  • Proficiency with program/project management tools (e.g., Wrike, SharePoint, Confluence, Jira) and GRC platforms (e.g., Archer, Vanta, ServiceNow GRC, or similar).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Person residing in the U.S. (FedRAMP Moderate/High requirement).

Nice to Haves

  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program management certification.
  • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.
  • HITRUST Certified CSF Practitioner (CCSFP).
  • CISSP, CISA, or CISM.
  • Experience supporting a FedRAMP JAB or Agency authorization from initiation through ATO, including familiarity with OSCAL and continuous monitoring deliverables.

This role is crucial in bridging the gap between our core engineering teams, ongoing projects, and the internal consumers of our platform. You will act as a key enabler, ensuring that our engineering teams can build and deploy services consistently, securely, and at scale. At Anaplan we host our customer workspaces on Kubernetes clusters deployed in different regions around the world. From time to time we need to move our customers between these clusters, migrate workspaces from data centers to cloud environments, and perform re-pooling operations to optimize resource allocation.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about developer experience, automation, and building robust, self-service platforms. You will be an advocate for best practices and a driving force for platform adoption and engagement across the organization.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be:

  • Executing migrations : DC to cloud migrations for chosen customers, and re-pooling operations for projects using our specialized tooling and CI/CD pipelines
  • Act as a Bridge:Serve as a primary point of contact and facilitator between central platform teams and various engineering and project teams to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.
  • Promote Platform Usage:Champion the adoption and effective use of the platform's tools and services, providing guidance and support to development teams to maximize their productivity.
  • Standardise Pattern Usage:Develop and enforce standardised patterns for infrastructure, deployment, and security to ensure consistency, reliability, and compliance across all services.
  • Drive Engagement:Actively engage with the developer community through workshops, documentation, and direct support to build a strong feedback loop and foster a culture of shared ownership.
  • Facilitate Onboarding:Streamline the onboarding process for new teams and services, providing them with the necessary tools, documentation, and support to get up and running quickly.
  • Gather and Action Feedback:Establish channels to continuously gather feedback from platform users and translate it into actionable improvements for the platform roadmap.
  • Participating in on-call rotations to support critical migration activities

Required:

  • Degree in Computer Science, equivalent degree, or demonstrated experience working in a technology company
  • Proven experience in a Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role.
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Proficiency with containerisation and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Solid experience with CI/CD principles and tools (e.g., ArgoCD, Jenkins, Git ).
  • Excellent scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to empathize with customer concerns during critical migrations

Desired Experience:

  • Quick learner with a genuine desire to understand sophisticated systems and software behavior
  • Genuine passion for problem solving with the persistence needed to resolve complex technical issues
  • Strong analytical skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
  • Ability to work effectively under time constraints within an exciting, fast-paced environment

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer 

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
